mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_dataset (dataset_id, dataset_name, description, item_count, items_json, version, pool, source, frozen, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{datasetName}, #{description}, #{itemCount}, #{itemsJson}, #{version}, #{pool}, #{source}, #{frozen}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, dataset_id, dataset_name, description, item_count, version, pool, source, frozen, create_time, update_time FROM eval_dataset WHERE dataset_name = #{datasetName} ORDER BY version DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM eval_dataset WHERE dataset_name = #{datasetName}
mapper.update: UPDATE eval_dataset SET frozen = #{frozen}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
